#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
umask 077
if [[ $# -lt 1 ]]; then
 printf '%s\n' '사용법: bash ./GENOS_FUNCTION_TIMING_20261024_R2.txt find /정확한/보고서날짜폴더 | extract /정확한/보고서.json [--code-root ~/DEV] | check | apply | gate [--committed] [--generation /정확한/세대] | rollback'
 exit 2
fi
mkdir -p ./GENOS_TIMING_RESULTS
probe_out=$(mktemp -d "./GENOS_TIMING_RESULTS/DETAIL-R2-$(date +%Y%m%dT%H%M%S)-XXXXXX")
printf '결과 폴더: %s\n' "$probe_out"
set +e
{
 python3 - "$probe_out" "$@" <<'PROBE_BOOTSTRAP_PY'
import base64,io,os,sys,zipfile,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
out=Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve()
print('Python:',sys.executable,sys.version.split()[0],flush=True)
assets=out/'package';assets.mkdir()
raw=base64.b64decode('',validate=True)
with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(raw)) as archive:archive.extractall(assets)
mode=sys.argv[2];args=sys.argv[3:]
if mode=='extract':
    if not args:raise SystemExit('extract에 정확한 요청 JSON/gzip 경로를 지정하세요.')
    command=[sys.executable,str(assets/'extract.py'),*args,'--output-dir',str(out)]
elif mode=='find':
    if len(args)!=1:raise SystemExit('find에 정확한 보고서 날짜 폴더 하나를 지정하세요.')
    command=[sys.executable,str(assets/'find_reports.py'),args[0]]
else:
    command=[sys.executable,str(assets/'installer.py'),mode,'--state',str(Path.cwd()/'GENOS_FUNCTION_TIMING_STATE_R2'),*args]
raise SystemExit(subprocess.call(command))
PROBE_BOOTSTRAP_PY
} 2>&1 | tee "$probe_out/EXECUTION.log"
probe_statuses=("${PIPESTATUS[@]}")
probe_status=${probe_statuses[0]}
if [[ ${probe_statuses[1]} -ne 0 ]]; then probe_status=${probe_statuses[1]}; fi
set -e
printf '%s\n' "$probe_status" > "$probe_out/EXIT_CODE.txt"
printf '종료=%s / 결과=%s\n' "$probe_status" "$probe_out"
exit "$probe_status"
